ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white) regions localized on the distal left lobe and right tip.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity contiguous white mottling on the distal-lateral portion of the left lobe; high-intensity cluster at the distal tip of the right lobe; predominantly low-intensity pixels across the central and medial regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an estimated interior angle of 45 degrees; notch depth occupies approximately 20% of the visible vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge; peaks and valleys are most prominent on the right lobe with jagged, high-amplitude protrusions at the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edges with a sharp distal taper; trailing edges exhibit a jagged horizontal sweep from the median notch to the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast, circular white pixel groups concentrated on the distal tip and outer margin of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of 3-4 parallel, vertically-oriented linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on the lower-central ventral surface near the water line.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy textural encrustation and physical protrusion on the right lobe tip; highly irregular and jagged trailing edge topography indicating significant physical wear or trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant asymmetry in surface texture and barnacle colonization between the right tip (heavily encrusted) and the left tip (relatively smooth).
